bondPercent.label: Masque of the Red Death, Bond of Life 130%
bondPercent.reason: She absorbs her Skill's Blood-Debt Due for a Bond of Life of 130% before her Normal Attacks, which makes them Pyro and adds the Masque's damage; the Bond shrinks as she attacks.

c6AfterSkill.label: Constellation 6 crits after Skill
c6AfterSkill.reason: With Constellation 6 her Skill, cast at the start of her combo, gives her Normal Attacks and Burst the crit bonus for 20 seconds, which lasts through the attacks that follow.
